leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a form state object with multiple input fields
Implement an event handler to update form state on user input
Bind form input elements to the state object using JavaScript
Construct a validation function to check form field requirements
Render dynamic feedback based on validation results
Reset the form state to its initial values
Integrate form submission with state management logic
lessonTitle: Build form state manager from scratch
